items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: so Bobby Hackett had asked me, and this was late '49, if I wanted to go into Nick's with him

ctx.x: Anyway, you asked me how did I happen to go in the Nick's Well, Bobby Hackett too me in, but beforehand I must say, Bobby Hackett, the great trumpet player, we had been friends for years, going back to Boston, before he came to New York. The one thing that happened to me, I fell in love with little bands while playing with Kirby, but I had been -- I was sick to death of moving brass sections. Do you follow me? I was just sick to death of it, killing myself -- and all of a sudden, it came to me, once I found the…
